summary: Import thunk (stdcall) that forwards sendto(s, buf, len, flags, to, tolen) to the imported Winsock implementation __imp_sendto. Sends len bytes from buf over socket s to destination address to. No local logic; the entire behavior is the forwarded import.

operations.description: Forward the call to the imported Winsock function __imp_sendto(s, buf, len, flags, to, tolen), which performs the actual datagram transmission.
Return the int result of the forwarded import call (bytes sent, or an error code).
Used by sub_562610, sub_562AC0, sub_5630D0 and sub_563AB0 to transmit network datagrams.
